name: popsicle
headline: Azure CEO: Scalable Marketing Automation
short_description: The azure-ceo skill uses Azure AI services and a multi-agent architecture to automate scalable marketing campaigns. It combines data-driven strategies with compliance, enhancing marketing efficiency and effectiveness.
author: cogitomancer

sections.overview:
Azure CEO is a multi-agent AI system built on Semantic Kernel and Azure OpenAI that automates marketing workflows through data-driven decision support. It combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) across structured and unstructured data with a modular orchestration layer, enabling teams to generate and test marketing content at scale. The system integrates Azure AI Search for grounding, FastAPI backend services for coordination, and built-in A/B/n testing capabilities to evaluate output quality. A compliance and safety layer handles input validation and Azure Content Safety integration, making it suitable for production marketing environments. This architecture supports both isolated campaign workflows and extensible agent-based systems for enterprise marketing automation.
Automating email marketing campaigns
Personalizing customer outreach
Analyzing campaign performance data
Integrating with CRM systems for lead management
- **Objective**: Increase lead generation by 30% in the renewable energy sector
- **Budget**: $50,000
- **Duration**: 3 months
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing strategist using Azure AI services. Design a scalable campaign for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use [DATA] to optimize targeting and compliance. Include budget allocation, channel strategy, and performance metrics.
```
